text: Contract detail for implementation: require all three first-level.yml jobs (full-repository, focused-first-level, scientific-coverage) to complete successfully. Resolve their API display contexts from the recorded jobs response rather than guessing context strings. scenario-receipts.yml must provide both locked R and Python regeneration jobs and artifacts. Inspect current YAML to resolve exact job IDs; fail if the adopted inventory and returned run disagree. A skipped required job is not success.
